_comment: Scores published by /v1/spec and the docs page. Two hardcoded copies of these numbers drifted (30.96 in evaluate.py vs 30.65 in server.py), and the published comparison mixed grid resolutions, so a 40x28 policy was being credited with beating a 20x14 bar. One table, one protocol, measured together.

labels.random: picks a grid cell at random
labels.aim_at_zone: flies straight at the target zone, ignores runway heading
labels.scripted_greedy: GreedyRouter, routes once per aircraft (engine-level, grid-free)
labels.hand_coded_bar: aim + line up with the runway, re-decides continuously
